jobs.occupation: (Senior) Process Scientist - New Tablet Drug Products
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As (Senior) Process Scientist, you will help move new tablet products from development into reliable, large-scale production. You will characterise, test, and validate tablet production processes so they work at manufacturing sites around the world, and prepare the documentation that supports market approval. Oral treatments are a strategic focus area at Novo and your work will help our patients and customers towards lasting health.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• An M.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering or another relevant academic area.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in oral product production, late-stage product development, drug product analysis, or clinical manufacturing

• General experience working within a GMP environment, knowledge of validation activities, and familiarity with regulatory documentation.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with team success ahead of personal achievement.

• A self-driven, quality-minded approach, with good planning and time-management skills to meet ambitious deadlines.

• Comfort working with some unknowns and many stakeholders, and the ability to adapt, learn and stay in control when situations are challenging.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience from cross-organisational projects.

We welcome applications from both experienced and more junior candidates. The scope of the role can be adjusted to your level of experience, providing an opportunity to grow into the position. If you meet the core requirements, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Do

**You will work on late-phase manufacturing science for new tablet products, preparing processes for large-scale market production.

**You Will Have The Opportunity To

**

• Drive scientific progress to reach project milestones, delivering on characterisation studies, test runs, and process validation activities.

• Work with production sites to solve technical challenges with blenders, granulators, tablet machines, in-process control systems, and process analytical technologies (PAT).

• Update and maintain critical process documentation, quality statements, scientific rationales and health authority submission files.

• Apply and uphold the relevant standards. Where a standard does not fully fit the situation, use your own scientific judgement to find the best way forward.

• Learn from how new ways of working meet reality at the sites, adapt your approach, and help update the standard so others can benefit.

The role is based in Taastrup, with some workdays in Måløv, and includes up to 25 international travel days a year, depending on your project.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join New Product Introduction (NPI) within Tablet Manufacturing Science and Technology (TMSAT) in Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS). Tablet MSAT supports the global network of tablet manufacturing sites by introducing new products, managing the processes and quality of marketed products, and developing new technology to improve performance.

NPI is a rapidly growing department of around 20 colleagues, working with an expanding pipeline of tablet products. Together, we develop, scale up and validate blending, granulation and compression processes, and make sure the product’s stability, specifications and quality hold up. We work in cross-functional project groups, united by shared team goals, and we share experience and knowledge as we go.

You will collaborate closely with development departments, production sites, quality assurance, quality control, regulatory affairs and the scientists who support marketed products. The stakeholders you work with will change as projects move forward, so you will keep building your network.

**What You Can Expect Here

**Oral treatments are a strategic focus area for Novo, and the landscape is dynamic. That means varied projects, new ways to broaden your skills and a chance to see your work make a difference at sites around the world. You will have a highly engaged, supportive team around you, and room to develop your professional and personal competences as the department grows.

**Salary

**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 638,200.00 to 938,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take new tablet products from development to patients around the world, apply for the (Senior) Process Scientist role by 26 November 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Chris Arnrød Andersen, Director at ciaq@novonordisk.com or +45-30752190.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Freedom and responsibility. The team has a lot of both, with an open door whenever you need input.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend engineer who cares that what you build works for the people using it, finds the way to the goal yourself, and knows which people to ask along the way.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We are looking for a Data Regulation Counsel to support Veo’s work within data protection and emerging technology regulation. You will play a key role in the day-to-day operation of Veo’s compliance framework and help ensure that our products, services, development, and internal processes meet applicable regulatory requirements.

You will join the Legal Team, currently consisting of four full-time employees, and work closely with it, as well as colleagues across IT, Marketing, Product, and other business areas. While the role's primary focus is GDPR compliance, your tasks will also include operational compliance related to NIS2, the Data Act, the Cyber Resilience Act, and the AI Act.

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing Legal function and help build scalable, pragmatic compliance processes at a company experiencing significant growth and continuous development.

**You can expect tasks within a variety of areas, including:

**

• Supporting the implementation and day-to-day operation of Veo’s data regulation compliance framework, ensuring that established processes are followed and continuously improved.

• Assisting in ensuring that Veo’s products, services, and internal data processing activities comply with applicable data regulation requirements.

• Providing practical and solution-oriented support to teams across Veo on data regulation matters, with a focus on translating legal requirements into operational processes.

• Drafting, updating, and maintaining relevant policies, procedures, and documentation, including privacy notices, records of processing activities, transfer impact assessments, incident response procedures, and documentation required under the regulatory frameworks.

• Supporting the handling of operational compliance tasks, including data subject rights requests, personal data breaches, and security incidents.

• Contributing to drafting and facilitating training and awareness initiatives.

• Supporting the management of third-party relationships from a compliance perspective, including assisting with due diligence, contractual requirements, and ongoing monitoring.

• Contributing to the ongoing monitoring, development, optimization, and, where relevant, automation of compliance processes, ensuring that Veo’s approach remains scalable and aligned with business needs.

Previous experience with all of the above is not required.

**Your qualifications:

**

• A master’s degree in law or business law from a Nordic university.

• Solid experience with advising on GDPR and/or other data regulation. Experience from scale ups or law firms is an advantage but not required..

• An interest in and basic understanding of broader technology regulation (e.g. NIS2, AI Act, Data Act).

• A pragmatic and structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to translate legal requirements into commercial and operational solutions.

• An interest in working closely with stakeholders across different functions and with varying professional backgrounds.

• A solid understanding of and interest in technology and artificial intelligence.

• The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

At Veo, the Legal Team is part of the Finance Department, and you will report to the Head of Legal. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate closely with our experienced Data Protection Counsel. We offer an informal working environment where individual contributions are highly valued, both professionally and socially. We encourage personal and professional development while providing a flexible work environment, even during busy periods.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

jobs.occupation: Student employee for Forward Trading & New Markets Technology
jobs.description:
Curious about software, data, and emerging technologies? Join a cross-functional tech team, build solutions for real energy trading, and grow your skills alongside experienced engineers.

The job

Here’s what the job entails

In the role as Junior Software Engineer, you will help develop and maintain software solutions that support energy trading in the forward market in close collaboration with software engineers, traders, and business stakeholders. You will participate in code reviews, agile development activities and continuous improvement initiatives, while developing your technical skills and bringing fresh ideas to the team.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• 
helping build tools that solve real problems for traders and analysts

• 
working on feature development alongside experienced software engineers

• 
gaining hands-on experience with Azure, CI/CD, APIs, databases, and professional software development practices

• 
participating in agile ceremonies, code reviews, and team knowledge sharing

The team

Meet the team

We are a cross-functional product team supporting the Forward Trading business area across both software engineering and data engineering. Our primary focus is to build and operate software products that support day-to-day trading activities. We provide traders and analysts with access to market data, analytics and insights, and we enable trading capabilities and support emerging market opportunities. We also automate business processes to improve efficiency and reliability and deliver scalable and maintainable solutions in close collaboration with business stakeholders.

We are a team of nine tech specialists with various backgrounds and interests. Being cross-functional means that you will get exposure to both software engineering and data engineering, giving you the opportunity to explore different technologies and develop your skills across disciplines. We are a social team with a special love for funny memes and a competitive edge. We always seek to do our best and help each other out.

From day one, you’ll help build software used by traders and analysts making decisions in European energy markets. Your solutions won’t sit in a backlog or a sandbox. They will support real trading activities and new market opportunities.

Sara Helligsøe Hauge

Head of Forward Trading & New Markets Technology

Your qualifications

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be working across both software and data engineering, we imagine that you are curious about technology and motivated to learn and develop your skills in a hands-on environment. You enjoy solving problems, exploring new technologies, and turning ideas into practical solutions. We also picture you as a team-oriented person who enjoys collaborating across disciplines while being comfortable taking responsibility for your own tasks. With a positive and proactive mindset, you are ready to contribute where needed in a dynamic environment.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• 
are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field

• 
have a keen interest in software development, AI, programming, data and emerging technologies such as agentic engineering

• 
have experience programming in Python and/or C#

• 
have some experience with SQL server, Databricks and streaming technologies like Pulsar or Kafka

• 
can work approx. 20 hours per week

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We offer

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work lifeto fit with your studies

Unlimited paid child’s sick daysbecause family comes first

Free tickets & discountsculture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

Barista caféhigh-quality coffee, always on us

On-site wellnessstate-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

HQ in the heart of Aarhuswith stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

The process

Recruitment process and relocation

You can read more about our recruitment process here. Please note that if you are an international candidate, we will reimburse travel expenses in connection with potential interviews and support you with the relocation process.

About us

What we’re about

At Danske Commodities, we trade energy across 40+ markets and deliver solutions for energy producers and large-scale consumers.

Our people work together to find value in everything we do and deliver it. For our partners. And for the energy system as a whole. Together with our parent company Equinor, we operate on a scale few trading houses can match.

Our organisation is flat with an open-door policy. We expect you to care. About your work. About your colleagues. And about the difference we make.

Aspiring chefs, beekeepers, runners, parents, gamers – we’re proud of our diversity of ideas. What binds us together is that we all find average genuinely uncomfortable and want to do something about it.

We’re big on trust and providing the freedom for you to thrive. Together, we’ll make sure you’ll be the best version of you. Because happy employees perform better and we’re in this for the long run. No matter the stage in life you’re in, we’ve got you.

Join us. You'll love Mondays.

A workplace like no other

In 2025, we moved into our new headquarters in the heart of Aarhus – a workplace built for the precision, focus and collaboration that define how we work. With state-of-the-art facilities, our own barista café, a modern fitness centre and views worth coming in for.

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Owner for Intelligence Engineering
jobs.description:
**Job Description

****Senior Product Owner

**Join us as we transform banking through data at Danske Bank. As Product Owner for Data Products, ML Enablement and MLops, you will help shape the future of personal banking by creating scalable data assets that power personalized customer experiences. This is your opportunity to lead meaningful change in financial services.

You will join the Customer Engagement Individuals Tribe as a Senior Product Owner with responsibility for driving the work needed to succeed with our strategy, together with, Engineers, Business Functional Specialists, Architects and more. In our department you will gain approximately 160 colleagues where you will lead one of the squads who will help enable Danske Bank to get ready for the next generation of banking services.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will lead a diverse team of data engineers, architects, and specialists across the Customer Engagement Individuals tribe, working on the group-wide AWS Databricks platform. Your work directly enables proactive, personalized banking services that build lasting customer relationships.

• Break down strategic priorities into vision and purpose for the team

• Drive the work leading leading to materialization of north star vision

• Lead development of data assets and products for commercial use cases

• Collaborate with data platform teams and deploy advanced analytics models using MLOps practices

• Manage stakeholders across the bank working with data development

• Guide conversion of PC platform to the group-wide data platform

• Align data development with regulatory, governance and security frameworks

• Mentor colleagues and foster learning in new technologies

• Bridge legacy systems to modern data platforms

**About You

**

• 5+ years of experience in Product Owner roles relevant to data products

• 3+ years of experience in financial services across different domains

• Proven background as data engineer, data thought-leader or leading data/ML engineering teams

• Familiarity with data platform concepts and knowledgeable about E2E data delivery

• Understanding of technical and data-architectural trade-offs

• Skilled in agile project management and associated activities

• Strategic mindset with ability to inspire team followership

• Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities

• Fluent in written and spoken English

Experience with real-time processing, data governance, or change management would be valuable additions to your profile.

**What We Offer You

**You will join approximately 160 colleagues in a diverse, international environment spanning the Nordics, Lithuania, and India. We support your growth through mentorship opportunities and exposure to cutting-edge banking technology. Our hybrid work model includes 3-4 days per week in the office to foster collaboration and knowledge sharing.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would love to hear from you if you are ready to shape the future of data-enabled banking. Please reach out to Mikkel Winther at mikkelw@danskebank.dk with any questions about this role.

At Heyra, we build AI systems, workflows and data platforms that are meant to live in production from day one. We work closely with companies that are moving quickly and need a partner who can hold both the strategic picture and the delivery reality in one head.

We're looking for a Deployment Strategist: the person the client's leadership talks to. You own the relationship and the outcome. You sit with a C-suite buyer, understand where their business is actually trying to go, and translate that into a sharp, sequenced plan for what we build and why. Then you steer a strong engineering team to make it real - without being the one in the codebase.

This is the strategic counterpart to our engineers. Where they go deep into the build, you hold the commercial and strategic frame: what problem are we really solving, what impact are we creating, in what order, and how do we get the organisation to adopt it. You're more product manager than a traditional consultant, with a strong strategic angle - closer to an Engagement Manager who's technical enough to make the right calls than a slide-deck advisor.

You'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists and designers in a company where ideas move quickly and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

• Owning client relationships at the leadership level - being the person the C-suite trusts

• Framing the real problem behind the ask, and shaping it into an engagement worth running together with our FDEs

• Sequencing what gets built, in what order, and being accountable for the business value - not just the artifact

• Steering engineering teams toward outcomes, translating in both directions between the client and the builders

• Driving adoption: managing expectations, working with the people who have to live with the solution, and staying through the part after launch

• Scoping, structuring and de-risking engagements as they evolve

• Spotting where the next opportunity sits inside an account and growing it

**Requirements

****You probably have experience with

**

• Management consulting, change management, adoption, implementation of AI-native solutions.

• Owning client or stakeholder relationships end to end, with real accountability for outcomes

• Product, programme or engagement leadership in a technical environment

• Being technically literate - fluent enough in data and AI to make the right calls and earn trust with both buyers and builders, without needing to write the production code yourself

• Translating between business strategy and what's actually buildable

• Bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations

• The patience to sit with a worried manager, and the stubbornness to stay until adoption actually lands

Curiosity, taste and the way you think matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience. We hire for the who, not the what - experience is an indicator of perspective, not a deciding factor for how senior a role you'll play here. We're hiring across levels and shape the role around the person.

Why Heyra

At Heyra, we believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We're building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build, and operate AI products that change how enterprises work - from problem to prototype to production.

We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high.

**You'll Join a Team Where

**

• people care deeply about what they build

• good ideas move quickly

• new technology gets explored early

• and where there is room to shape both the company and the way we work

We're around 50 people today after merging with Pyne, and we're only just getting started.

If owning how AI engagements get framed, sold and landed at Heyra sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

Would you like to lead and further develop the Finance function at Denmark’s largest refinery? Kalundborg Refinery is seeking an experienced Head of Finance to combine hands-on operational finance leadership with strategic influence on site performance.

The high requirements for safety, operational reliability and regulatory compliance in a critical industrial environment require strong financial leadership, clear governance and the ability to create effective collaboration across site operations and Group functions.

Kalundborg Refinery is critical infrastructure within Denmark’s energy supply system and accounts for more than 15% of the country’s total energy consumption. Since January 2022, the refinery has been part of Klesch Group and operates alongside a sister site in Heide, Germany, and a recently acquired refinery in Gelsenkirchen, also in Germany. Under Klesch Group ownership, Kalundborg Refinery continues to operate with an uncompromising focus on safe and reliable operations, operational excellence and long-term value creation.

As Head of Finance, you will lead the full Finance function at Kalundborg Refinery and act as the primary financial steward and business partner to the Site Managing Director. You will be closely connected to Group and report to the Group CFO, ensuring alignment with Group finance standards, controls and reporting. As a member of the Leadership Team, you will contribute to the Company’s overall business strategy and take responsibility for both day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives across Finance.

You will have overall leadership and management responsibility for Controlling, Accounting, budgeting and Tax in Kalundborg. Your key responsibilities include:

• Ensuring effective and efficient management and execution of all finance-related matters.

• Ensuring operational excellence within Finance and compliance with applicable requirements and Company policies.

• Overseeing quarterly financial reporting and the preparation of annual financial statements, ensuring clean, credible and on-time reporting with no material control gaps.

• Overseeing and monitoring relevant direct and indirect tax matters.

• Preparing monthly management information for the shareholder and senior leadership team. Ensuring an effective and timely monthly financial close.

• Driving the budgeting process in Kalundborg with close coordination with project managers and Group.

• Supporting the management of structured finance arrangements, including preparation for and participation in bank calls, liquidity planning and liquidity monitoring.

• Leading and developing the Finance team, strengthening KPI dashboard reporting and building clear succession visibility.

The right candidate has:

• A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field, combined with 8–12+ years of finance experience in multinational and manufacturing or industrial environments.

• A track record of leading a Finance team of comparable size, approximately 10–15 employees, at plant or site level.

• Strong command of IFRS and experience with financial reporting; consolidated reporting experience is an advantage.

• Experience with cost accounting, standard costing, capex appraisal, ERP systems — preferably SAP or equivalent — and advanced financial modelling and analysis.

• Fluency in a Scandinavian language and professional proficiency in English.

• The ability to operate confidently as a peer to plant operations leadership and manage stakeholders effectively across a dual reporting structure.

• Demonstrates dynamism and a continuous drive for results.

• Attention to detail and ability to present complex matters in a simple way.

• A demonstrated ability to develop and retain an engaged Finance team, communicate difficult financial truths with commercial tact and build strong functional capability.

The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark. Travel (app. 2 days per month) is to be expected.

Aarhus Airport is hiring an Analyst (Route Development & Marketing)

Aarhus Airport is growing – this year we are seeing a record number of passengers enjoy the very best customer experience of Denmark’s fastest growing airport while traveling to and from a widening number of destinations with our airline and tour operator partners. Can you see the next new opportunity and identify the latest trends to influence where customers will fly and how they get there? We will be welcoming more partners, destinations and guests, making use of ever-developing airport amenities that require planning, analysis and performance monitoring. To help us do so, we are looking for a new and talented colleague to join the strategic team that leads our route development, marketing and communications work. Energetically researching, monitoring, analysing and determining the data and insight that powers our planning and harnessing of valuable air capacity for Aarhus and the region, if you would like to be part of the team that shapes this connectivity strategy for the Nordic region’s fifth most populous metro area, to bring millions of customers to thousands of flights that service Aarhus Airport now and in the years to come, we want to hear from you.

Our ideal Analyst will be able to join as soon as possible and get to work on carrying-out market analysis of both existing and new potential routes, with both existing and future airline and tour operator partners. This opportunity is located at our brand-new offices at Aarhus Airport and will be an integral part of our team-spirited wider airport family, working across the organisation as required.

In this position your primary areas of responsibility will include:

• Analysing existing routes, potential routes and aviation market data, supporting work in growing passenger throughput, generating business cases and providing valuable data to the Route Development, Marketing & Communications team

• Helping attract and win new airline services, tour operators and air freight providers among other business development opportunities by way of sharp and investigative analysis

• Work astutely with market intelligence and data – from reporting, analysing, market-sizing and trend development, to identifying, researching and underpinning new business opportunity by smartly applying business acumen

• Develop a grasp and detailed understanding of population dynamics, socio-economic, migration and immigration as well as regional economic trends across Denmark and applicable international communities, as well as trade and tourism

• Using both new and available data and analytical methodology, support the commercial activity, sales, marketing and communication initiatives of the organisation

• Produce, research and maintain analytical and insight tools to help optimally showcase Aarhus Airport’s market, regional economy and destination assets

• Support the knowledge-building of AAR’s work in economic, aviation and wider industry trends

• Support work with stakeholders and business partners from around the industry and region including tourism partners, corporate customers, airlines and tour operator partners

• Assist with applicable project management and business development by way of competent planning, modelling, budgeting and forecasting

• Assist in commercial calculations, analysis and negotiations with management and leadership, in pursuit of incremental revenue sustainability and asset optimisation

• Co-operate closely with marketing, communications, administration, customer service and operational colleagues

• Attend and support airline and tour operator negotiations as required, including attendance of industry conferences, conventions and exhibitions. The role involves some international travel which should appeal to your general wanderlust and passion for travel, tourism and/or aviation

The right candidate will, among other attributes, demonstrate that they have:

• Strong skill sets in analytical, business and/or commercial arena and ideally some international work experience, or a very significant interest in this field. Perhaps you have worked in travel already or are keen to do so, maybe an interest in airport, airline and the travel sector in general

• A business degree of relevance with a lean towards statistical, data and analytical strengths, possibly within business, economics, marketing, communications or another commercial discipline

• Fluency in English, perhaps a Scandinavian language too. Additional languages are an advantage

• A head for numbers, strong IT and excellent interpersonal communication skills are a must. Fully competent in excel, powerpoint, other IT suites and data tools, where thinking outside of the box, challenging assumptions with evidence and insight, above all being inquisitive and solution-oriented are second nature

• The ability to work confidently and in a structured way with extensive data material and in detail, producing meaningful analysis, reports, proposals and delivering valuable insight to colleagues and decision-makers. At the same time you are able to work independently and as part of a team, tie dynamic data and insight together and present complex data in an attractive way, visually and verbally

• The ability to gain security clearance from the Danish Police, hold a valid passport and have or obtain the right to live and work in Aarhus, Denmark is a minimum requirement.

Aarhus Airport offers a range of benefits in line with qualifications and experience. We have towering ambitions for the future and invite you to join us if the above snapshot is a fit and you are keen to contribute in building the region’s future international connectivity, and the potential to develop your career with us excites you. We are an equal opportunities employer and an organisation that likes to stand out from the crowd, we thrive on excellence and diversity within our team regardless of background, ethnicity, gender or sexual orientation. We expect the review of applications and interviews to be ongoing until the position is filled, and encourage you to reach out as soon as possible if the opportunity resonates.

We look forward to receiving your CV and covering letter with an indication of salary expectations via the application link on our website. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us by email at dsu@aar.dk

Would you like to drive the commercial growth of a world-leading protein analysis contract research organization (CRO)? Alphalyse seeks a commercially driven Marketing Director to strengthen our market position and win new biopharmaceutical clients worldwide.

About the role

As Marketing Director, you will own Alphalyse’s marketing strategy and brand and be the central point for everything we communicate to the market. You will lead and develop our marketing function and work closely with management, sales, and our scientific experts. You will take ownership, set priorities, make decisions, and turn ideas into coordinated, high-quality material that reaches our clients.

Our market consists of a limited number of biopharmaceutical companies, and many of them do not yet know what modern protein analysis can do for them. Educating the market is therefore a key part of the job, and so is making sure that our strong scientific profile is matched by a clear commercial message.

The position is based at our headquarters in Odense, Denmark, and you will lead our communications specialist and work closely with our sales and business development teams in both Denmark and the United States.

Your responsibilities

• Develop and execute the marketing strategy and plan, aligned with our commercial goals

• Be the guardian of the Alphalyse brand, and own the communication plan, PR, and our external newsletter

• Identify target accounts and decision-makers, and run account-based campaigns that generate qualified leads

• Educate the market through webinars, case studies, and thought leadership.

• Define the right marketing KPIs, track performance, and adjust quickly based on what generates pipeline

• Be the landing place for good ideas from across the organization for client material, posts, and content. Decide what to pursue and turn it into finished output

• Coordinate all marketing material, so our messaging is consistent across channels, client meetings, sales, and events

• Plan and run conferences and events, and make sure we show up with strong material

• Lead and develop our communications specialist, and act as a business development partner to sales and management

Who you are

You are a commercially minded marketing leader with high personal drive and a hands-on approach. You thrive on handling many different activities at once and keep momentum without losing sight of priorities. You are a strong communicator, an engaged people leader, and a natural sparring partner for management and sales. You quickly grasp complex technical offerings and explain their value clearly to scientists and decision-makers alike. You are an early adopter of AI and always look for smarter ways of working.

Professional qualifications

Required

• Deep B2B marketing and branding experience at a strategic level, including developing and implementing marketing strategies

• Proven track record of marketing a niche, technical B2B product or service to a small, well-defined customer base

• Strong commercial instincts and comfort being measured on pipeline and revenue

• A proven ability to turn strategy into execution across PR, content, events, campaigns, and product launches

• Experience leading and developing employees, including setting priorities and making decisions for a team

• Excellent written and spoken English

Preferred

• Experience with account-based marketing and CRM tools

• Experience educating a market about new technologies or services

• Experience with websites, digital marketing, and video content

• Knowledge of the biopharmaceutical industry, life science, or analytical techniques

What we offer

• A senior role with real influence on Alphalyse’s commercial strategy and growth

• The chance to shape our marketing as the company grows

• Close collaboration with management, a world-class scientific team and our sales organization

• A market where regulatory change is creating new demand for our services

Are you interested?

To apply, please send your CV to job@alphalyse.com no later than 10 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you have questions about the role, please contact CEO Thomas Kofoed at +45 2045 2038.

About Alphalyse

Alphalyse is a Danish contract research laboratory founded in 2002. We use our passion for protein analysis to help clients develop safe and effective biopharmaceuticals. An innovative approach has made us world leaders in quantifying Host Cell Proteins using a unique mass spectrometry method.

Our technical experts make the analysis results accessible to understand and use, and they take pride in building strong and rewarding relationships with our clients. Our most important asset is our team of highly skilled employees, and we encourage a work environment that is exciting, challenging, and fun.

Learn more at www.alphalyse.com

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Senior Coordinator, Product Data Management (PDM), you'll play a key role in ensuring that our product data is accurate, consistent and accessible across our global engineering organization.

You'll be part of the PL40 Engineering organization and work closely with our Global Product Data Management team, connecting colleagues, systems and processes across different functions and locations. From maintaining critical product information to supporting new product development and global system implementations, your work will help teams make better decisions and operate more efficiently.

Your impact? You'll go beyond managing data — you'll help improve how we work with it. By driving standardization, identifying opportunities for automation and coordinating improvements across sites, you'll contribute to more reliable processes, smoother project execution and better data quality throughout Danfoss.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**In this role, you will:

• Own and maintain high-quality product master data, including material masters, Bills of Materials (BOMs), classifications, technical documentation and product labels, ensuring accuracy and consistency across systems.

• Support colleagues and coordinate PDM activities across functions and locations, providing guidance on systems, preparing risk assessments, analyzing data in Excel and ensuring timely resolution of data-related issues.

• Drive local and global process improvements, identifying opportunities for standardization, optimization and automation while collaborating with the Global PDM team and service excellence centers.

• Contribute to key business and system projects, including OneERP implementation, PLM-related initiatives and Product Data Management improvements, ensuring effective implementation at the local site.

• Coordinate product data activities within New Product Development (NPD) projects, working closely with the Global NPD Coordinator, engineering teams and international stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely product data availability.

**What We're Looking For

**

• A technical or administrative educational background, combined with at least 3–5 years of experience in Product Data Management, master data or a similar area.

• Strong SAP and Microsoft Excel skills, with practical experience managing complex product data; familiarity with Siemens Teamcenter or other PLM systems would be a valuable advantage.

• A structured, detail-oriented and quality-focused approach, with a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency and a zero-defect mindset.

• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to take ownership, prioritize tasks, drive improvements and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, fluency in written and spoken English, and the confidence to work effectively with stakeholders across different functions and international locations.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• A role with real ownership and impact, where your work directly supports product development, engineering operations and the quality of critical business data.

• The opportunity to contribute to global transformation initiatives, including OneERP implementation, process standardization and improvements to Product Data Management systems.

• International collaboration with our Global PDM team in Denmark, engineering colleagues and stakeholders across multiple Danfoss locations.

• The chance to develop your expertise in SAP, PLM systems, master data governance and process optimization, while taking an active role in improving the way we work.

• A supportive and collaborative engineering environment where your ideas are valued, continuous improvement is encouraged and you can build your professional network within a global organization.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

**At GN, we are bringing people closer, and through our Jabra brand, we are leading major technology shifts with intelligent audio solutions.

**We are looking for an Audio DSP Test Engineer to join our Audio DSP team and help develop, maintain, and improve our audio test systems for audio platforms used in Jabra headsets, earbuds, and accessories.

The position is based in our HQ in Ballerup, where we have our test setup.

You will join 20 highly skilled and dedicated colleagues. We are organised in agile teams, each with a maximum of 8 developers, 1 Scrum Master, and 1 Product Owner. You will report to the Line Manager, audio DSP ESW, while your daily work will be carried out closely with your team and the projects you are allocated to.

**What will you be doing?

**As an Audio DSP Test Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and robustness of our Audio DSP software through automated hardware testing, software testing of DSP code, and audio validation based on a DSP.

You will work with our automatic HW test system, developing and maintaining test frameworks, test cases, tools, and infrastructure used to validate audio DSP features on real target hardware.

**Your Work Will Include

**

• Providing insights into test strategy and best practices

• Developing, maintaining, and improving automated HW test systems for Audio DSP platforms

• Designing and implementing automated test cases for audio features and DSP algorithms

• Integrating test solutions with embedded software builds and continuous integration workflows

• Debugging failures across test software, embedded DSP software, hardware, and test equipment

• Analysing test results, identifying root causes, and collaborating with developers to resolve issues

• Supporting validation of audio performance, stability, interfaces, and system behaviour on target hardware

• Improving test coverage, test reliability, execution time, and reporting

• Documenting test setups, test methods, and results

**Sound good so far? Here’s what you’ll need to succeed:

**

• You have a degree in electrical engineering, computer science, software engineering, or similar

• You have experience with embedded software testing, test automation, or hardware-in-the-loop testing

• You have experience scripting and test tooling in Python, and preferably developing software in C/C++

• You have experience with embedded debugging and analysing issues across hardware and software

• You have an interest in audio DSP software, audio processing, and validation of audio features

• You understand fixed- and floating-point signal processing, or are motivated to build expertise in this area

• You are comfortable working systematically with test design, automation, troubleshooting, and data analysis

Experience with Bluetooth chipsets, such as Airoha, Qualcomm, or other platforms using Tensilica HiFi cores, is an advantage.

**A keen interest in relevant technologies and methods

**You do not need to be an expert in every aspect of automated testing or audio DSP from day one. However, curiosity, a structured mindset, and motivation to learn new technologies and methods will take you far at GN.

We work with DSP, embedded development, DSP architectures, interfaces such as I2S/TDM, C/C++, Python, Git, code review tools, automated test frameworks, and laboratory test equipment.

**Team-player spirit

**While there are plenty of opportunities for each team member to develop their individual skill set, we are first and foremost a team.

**Fluent Written And Spoken English Skills

**Our official company language is English.

**The GN Audio culture

**The GN Audio culture is upbeat and positive. We greet every day with energy and enthusiasm and approach problem-solving and challenges with a “glass half full” attitude.

We are a multicultural team with colleagues in several countries. The team is a mix of local and remote colleagues, and online collaboration is part of our DNA.
